name: The Idle Cloud (Nhàn Vân Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: when your reflection-double falls, the Plain Silk Scroll keeps the ward it grew and gives it to you; and the first time each fight your health falls below half, you regain the health and linh lực you lost in the last 3 s.

story: Her own silk, her master's brush and her own robe. Diệp Tố Quyên holds all three. The founder's half sky is not a piece, and she will not let anyone make it one.

name: Mother's Sky (Mẫu Thiên Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Figure on the Clouds (Vân Thượng Nhân)
bonuses.rule: your reflection-double lasts 3 s longer and, while it stands, your Water arts cost 10 % less; when it falls you gain 2 Water buff stacks.

story: Her mother's last scroll and her mother's brush. Tần Đảo Ảnh holds both.
